_tokenSources: Where the tokens these files read are DECLARED. roots is src, but the tokens live in the submodule, so without this every var() into shared reads as undefined.
_runtimeTokens: Set by JS as an inline style on the element itself, so no stylesheet declares them: the zone/tab colours and --labels-w from App.tsx + GlyphGroups.tsx, --flash-color from scenes.tsx, and --vs/--vm-lh/--vm-shift from CossScene.tsx.
